traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), families 59-65 (Myricaceae, Betulaceae, Fagaceae, Corylaceae, Juglandaceae), which with Nothofagaceae and Casuarinaceae make APG's Fagales: trees or shrubs; leaves alternate; flowers unisexual, mostly monoecious (Myricaceae sometimes dioecious); the male flowers in catkins or catkin-like spikes; the female calyx adnate to an inferior ovary (Myricaceae's ovary is naked).

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Fagales page (read 2026-10-16): spiral leaves listed for the clade of all families except Nothofagaceae; Fagaceae usually spiral, Fagus and some Quercoideae two-ranked; Nothofagaceae two-ranked. DELTA Betulaceae: spiral to distichous.

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Fagales page (read 2026-10-16): Fagaceae and Nothofagaceae simple; DELTA Betulaceae simple; Juglandaceae pinnate (family states it).

traits.division_pattern.note: Only Juglandaceae has compound leaves (pinnate, stated); oak and birch lobing/venation is pinnate. APweb Fagales page (read 2026-10-16) has pinnately veined serrate blades.

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Fagales page (read 2026-10-16): trees and shrubs with leafy shoots throughout.

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Fagales page (read 2026-10-16): woody order (order already states woody).

traits.flowering_position.note: DELTA Betulaceae (read 2026-10-16): inflorescences terminal; APweb Fagaceae: catkins and cupule-forming dichasia (axillary in oaks and chestnuts from my knowledge). Weighted by Fagaceae (~1,000 of ~1,200 spp.).

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Fagales page (read 2026-10-16): small wind-pollinated flowers with an undifferentiated perianth or none.

traits.flower_merosity.note: APweb, Fagales page (read 2026-10-16): Fagaceae often trimerous (perianth 4-6), Nothofagus carpellate flowers 2-merous; DELTA Betulaceae: male perianth 0 or 2-4. Replaces inherited Pentapetalae 4-5 typical 5, wrong for this order.

traits.perianth.note: APweb, Fagales page (read 2026-10-16): Fagaceae perianth of 4-6 joined members, Nothofagus reduced or none; DELTA Betulaceae: sepal-like scales or none. No petals anywhere, so inherited sepals_and_petals is wrong.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Fagales page (read 2026-10-16): no floral cup; the cupule in Fagaceae is a bract structure, not a hypanthium.

traits.stamens.note: APweb, Fagales page (read 2026-10-16): Fagaceae usually 4-20 (about 12), Nothofagus 10-15; DELTA Betulaceae 2-4; Casuarina 1. Typical 6 is my weighting (Quercus 6).

traits.carpels.note: APweb, Fagales page (read 2026-10-16): Fagaceae 3 (6-12 in some), Nothofagus 2-3; DELTA Betulaceae 2.

traits.fruit_type.note: APweb, Fagales page (read 2026-10-16): fruits single-seeded; nuts in cupules (Fagaceae, Nothofagus); DELTA Betulaceae: nut or winged samara; Myrica drupes.
